prepared_arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer. Final targeted revision of the close dialogue portrait in Image 1. Image 1 is the edit target; Image 2 is Turi's original identity master; Images 3–6 are strict low-resolution facial-cluster style references. Preserve his identity: lean narrow-cheeked man around forty, warm weathered skin, swept tousled BROWN hair crown, distinct gray temple patches, dark eyebrows, compact salt-gray moustache and short goatee, muted olive-green cape and tiny off-white collar. Not a white-haired elder.
Correct these together: replace the current large cream-white eye wedges with MUCH SMALLER narrow dark attentive eyes, no more than 1–2 logical pixels high, with only tiny muted tan-gray sclera accents and no bright white. Maintain a firm nearly level eyebrow line with a subtle skeptical asymmetry, a serious measured appraisal and a small slightly parted mouth explaining only what he inspected. Make nose and hollow cheekbone shapes large broad contiguous planes; preserve the mature lean anatomy without adding old-age wrinkles.
Shorten the long neck to just 3–4 logical pixels. Put the chin near logical y=88; only a tiny 5–7 pixel olive-green collar strip at the bottom, with a small muted off-white inner edge. Remove the broad shoulders and long V-neck from the composition. This is a FACE portrait. Keep the entire swept brown hair and gray-temple silhouette and visible ear, leaving real 2-pixel transparency left/right and above hair and 1 pixel below collar. Hair and gray temples need 3–4 bold connected clusters; REMOVE the repetitive narrow parallel stripe highlights. Keep gray cropped facial hair in a few solid masses.
74×100 logical pixel hard-edged medieval RPG dialogue portrait, at most 32 flat earthy colors, fully transparent background. Match the coarse, mature facial anatomy of Images 3–6. No gradients, smooth painting, antialiasing, dithering, noisy strands, big white eyes, long neck, chest, new injury, text or scene. One portrait.
